checks.name: Existing athlete/club login and athlete submission regression
Analytics matches filtered SQL counts, unique athletes, statuses, empty and quotas
Snapshot is recalculated server-side, readable cross-account, immutable, and access-controlled
Private documents validate content, size and owner; draft deletion and legacy bypass denied
Roster rejects cross-sport, missing documents and unconfirmed submissions
Roster draft persists main/reserve, checks version and submits once with approval histories
Submitted roster locks new and legacy APIs; retained documents cannot be deleted
Staff return resets application states, preserves histories and permits resubmit
Concurrent rosters from different clubs cannot exceed shared sport quota
Official signup normalizes email, prevents namespace collisions and ignores caller role
Official drafts persist, require plan/id-card/other detail and ownership
Official submit routes through club before staff; cross-club review/read denied
Club rejection and staff rejection both allow resubmit from SUBMITTED preserving audit
Disabled accounts, changed roles, expired sessions and direct APIs are rejected
All new pages render with role cookies, public signup is accessible and routes guard roles
Exact fixture cleanup (database and private storage)
